context_requirements: Bacterial DNA gyrase (GyrA/GyrB) must be present and essential; human cells lack this enzyme.
For off-target effects, sufficient exposure to human topoisomerase II or other annotated targets may be required, but this is not the class mechanism.
falsifiers: Reproducible, concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in multiple cell lines.
A shared transcriptional signature across the nine cell lines that is distinct from generic stress responses.
Evidence of DNA damage response or topoisomerase II inhibition signature after treatment.
